best_for: PC gamers who keep a browser open next to a game and want to cap how much memory, CPU and bandwidth it takes, with Twitch and Discord in the sidebar.

points.title: Caps on what the browser can use
points.text: GX Control lets you set limits on RAM, CPU and network use from a speedometer icon in the sidebar. The point is to keep the browser from stealing frames or ping from a running game.

points.title: Close the worst tabs fast
points.text: Hot Tabs Killer shows which tabs use the most resources and closes them in one click. A hard RAM limit goes further and drops inactive tabs from memory right away.

points.title: Twitch and Discord built in
points.text: The sidebar shows which Twitch channels you follow are live and can hold Discord, WhatsApp and Telegram. GX Corner adds free game offers, deals and a release calendar.

points.title: Same free extras as Opera
points.text: A free ad blocker and a free browser VPN come with it, as in regular Opera. The free VPN covers only the browser; VPN Pro for the whole device is a separate product.

points.title: Free, with a proprietary license
points.text: Opera GX costs nothing to download and use, but it is closed source.

points.title: Mac and Windows here, Linux elsewhere
points.text: This site lists Windows and macOS. Opera's own download page also offers GX for Linux as .deb, .rpm and a Flathub build.

points.title: Downgrading
points.text: The Windows listing has 32-bit and 64-bit builds, per-user or all-users, and keeps 152 versions. The Mac build is universal and needs macOS 13 or later; macOS lists only the current release.
